description: This file defines a WeatherNow component for a LightningJS-based weather display application. It renders current weather conditions including temperature, humidity, wind, and weather icon, and responds to global store updates and user interaction.

classes.name: WeatherNow
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays current weather conditions, including temperature, condition, icon, feels-like temperature, humidity, and wind, with interactive focus support and navigation.

methods.name: panelBg
methods.description: Returns a theme color for panel background with slight translucency.

methods.name: focusOutline
methods.description: Returns a theme color used for the focus outline.

methods.name: textPrimary
methods.description: Returns the primary text color from theme.

methods.name: textSecondary
methods.description: Returns a secondary (less prominent) text color from theme.

methods.name: mainTemp
methods.description: Computes and returns formatted main temperature string based on current weather data and units.

methods.name: conditionText
methods.description: Returns the weather condition description or a placeholder.

methods.name: feelsLikeText
methods.description: Returns string indicating the 'feels like' temperature.

methods.name: humidityText
methods.description: Returns humidity percentage string or placeholder.

methods.name: windText
methods.description: Returns formatted wind speed and direction string.

methods.name: iconSrc
methods.description: Maps current weather icon code to an asset image source path.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets the component as focused, updating visual state.
